comment: group_window_minutes: rolling gap threshold for clustering alerts into root-cause groups (default 30). max_runs_per_day counts groups (investigations), not individual alert messages. poll_window_minutes is 65 so we never miss a message landing right at the hourly boundary. stability_review.max_spend_usd is the per-run cap for the monthly stability-review routine (separate from the global cap). suppression_window_hours: known-issue-recurrence DMs suppressed within this window after the entry's last_notified_at; #swat and every-10th-occurrence resurface anyway. daily_escalation_cap: max non-swat needs-human DMs per UTC day; excess append to docs/actionable/<date>.md. escalation_score_threshold: minimum impact+corroboration-inhibition score to send a needs-human DM (below threshold goes to actionable.md). actionable_score_threshold: below this score, the actionable.md entry is a terse one-line summary; between this and escalation_score_threshold, the entry gets full score_breakdown + suggested action. critical_path_services: services that count as 'sign-in/core path' for the scoring rubric.
